nodes.name: evolution-runs.ts
nodes.summary: Provides the EvolutionRunStore class for persisting and managing AI self-improvement evolution run records in SQLite, including lifecycle transitions (propose, accept, reject, deploy, fail) with status tracking and querying.

nodes.name: EvolutionRunStore
nodes.summary: SQLite-backed store for evolution run records that manages full lifecycle (proposed → accepted/rejected → deployed/failed) with UUID-keyed lookups, filtered listing, and status count aggregation.

nodes.name: execution-traces.ts
nodes.summary: Provides the ExecutionTraceStore class for recording, appending to, and querying agent execution traces stored in SQLite, capturing session context, cost, duration, and outcome for each agent invocation.

nodes.name: ExecutionTraceStore
nodes.summary: Manages execution trace records in SQLite, supporting start/append/finalize lifecycle, correction marking, filtered querying, and outcome count aggregation per persona/workspace/model.

nodes.name: frames.ts
nodes.summary: Core memory frame storage layer providing the FrameStore class that implements I/P/B-frame video-codec-inspired memory compression, FTS indexing, deduplication via content hashing, and compaction of older memory groups.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a video codec (I/P/B-frame) metaphor for memory compression: I-frames are full snapshots, P-frames are incremental patches, and B-frames are bidirectional references.

nodes.name: FrameStore
nodes.summary: SQLite-backed memory frame store implementing I/P/B-frame creation, GOP (group of pictures) reconstruction, FTS indexing, content-hash deduplication, access tracking, importance-based compaction, and vector index maintenance.

nodes.name: identity.ts
nodes.summary: Provides the IdentityLayer class for persisting and retrieving a single personal identity record (name, role, department, personality, capabilities) that can be injected into agent system prompts.

nodes.name: IdentityLayer
nodes.summary: SQLite-backed singleton identity store that creates, reads, and partially updates the user's personal identity record, with a toContext helper for agent prompt injection.

nodes.name: improvement-signals.ts
nodes.summary: Provides the ImprovementSignalStore class for tracking recurring agent behavior patterns (correction, confusion, tool failures) with frequency counters and actionable signal surfacing for the evolution subsystem.

nodes.name: ImprovementSignalStore
nodes.summary: Persists improvement signal patterns with upsert-on-conflict frequency counting, category-based retrieval, and actionable threshold filtering to surface the most impactful patterns for evolution.

nodes.name: inprocess-embedder.ts
nodes.summary: Provides an in-process HuggingFace Transformers.js embedding provider that loads a model locally and produces normalized float32 vectors, with optional dimension reduction via subarray truncation.

nodes.name: createInProcessEmbedder
nodes.summary: Factory that lazily loads a Transformers.js feature-extraction pipeline and returns an Embedder with embed/embedBatch methods that truncate or pad embeddings to the target dimension.

nodes.name: inprocess-reranker.ts
nodes.summary: Provides an in-process cross-encoder reranker using Transformers.js AutoModelForSequenceClassification, scoring query-document pairs with sigmoid normalization for memory retrieval re-ranking.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a cross-encoder (sequence classification) model rather than a bi-encoder, providing higher quality reranking at the cost of running inference per query-document pair.

nodes.name: createInProcessReranker
nodes.summary: Factory that loads a Transformers.js sequence classification model and tokenizer, returning a Reranker with score/scoreBatch methods that compute sigmoid-normalized relevance scores for query-document pairs.

nodes.name: knowledge.ts
nodes.summary: Provides the KnowledgeGraph class implementing entity-relation graph storage in SQLite with temporal validity windows, entity deduplication, BFS traversal, and schema-based property validation.

nodes.name: KnowledgeGraph
nodes.summary: SQLite knowledge graph with typed entities, directed relations, temporal validity (valid_from/valid_to), automated deduplication by normalized name, graph traversal (BFS), and optional JSON Schema validation of entity properties.

nodes.name: litellm-embedder.ts
nodes.summary: Provides a LiteLLM-backed embedding provider factory that calls the OpenAI-compatible /embeddings endpoint, with a deterministic mock fallback for development/testing when the API is unavailable.

nodes.name: createLiteLLMEmbedder
nodes.summary: Factory that constructs an HTTP-based embedder calling LiteLLM's /embeddings API, with mock fallback for non-OK responses or test mode; supports single and batch embedding.

nodes.name: ollama-embedder.ts
nodes.summary: Provides a local Ollama embedding provider factory that calls the Ollama HTTP API with a configurable timeout and delegates to an in-process embedder fallback when the model is not available remotely.

nodes.name: createOllamaEmbedder
nodes.summary: Factory returning an embedder that calls the Ollama HTTP API with timeout and applies dimension normalization, with embed and embedBatch methods.

nodes.name: raw-detail-lane.ts
nodes.summary: Implements the raw detail retrieval lane that fetches verbatim conversation turns from SQLite using FTS and date-window pooling, then re-ranks them with a cross-encoder reranker for high-fidelity memory recall.
nodes.languageNotes: The raw-detail lane is the primary driver of LoCoMo benchmark accuracy; ablation showed it contributes ~+14pp over the semantic lane alone.

nodes.name: fetchRawDetailLane
nodes.summary: Retrieves and reranks raw conversation turns from SQLite using a hybrid date-window+FTS pool, cross-encoder scoring, and surrounding-context expansion per conversation to maximize recall fidelity.

nodes.name: reconcile.ts
nodes.summary: Provides index reconciliation utilities to repair out-of-sync FTS and vector indexes by backfilling missing entries and removing orphaned records that no longer have corresponding memory frames.

nodes.name: schema.ts
nodes.summary: Exports the canonical SQLite DDL for the hive-mind memory substrate schema (version-stamped), including memory_frames, sessions, knowledge entities/relations, and vector table SQL generators parameterized by embedding dimension.
nodes.languageNotes: The vecTableSqlForDim and chunksVecTableSqlForDim functions generate sqlite-vec virtual table DDL dynamically based on the embedding dimension, enabling runtime model switching.

nodes.name: scoring.ts
nodes.summary: Provides memory frame scoring functions (temporal decay, popularity, contextual graph distance, importance tier) combined into a weighted relevance score used by HybridSearch to rank retrieved frames.

nodes.name: search.ts
nodes.summary: Core HybridSearch implementation combining FTS5 keyword search, ANN vector search, chunk-level retrieval, RRF fusion, optional cross-encoder reranking, and multi-dimensional relevance scoring for memory frame retrieval.

nodes.name: HybridSearch
nodes.summary: Orchestrates hybrid memory retrieval using parallel FTS5 + ANN vector search with RRF score fusion, optional chunk-level vector indexing for long frames, cross-encoder reranking, temporal date-window filtering, and GOPid scoping.

nodes.name: sessions.ts
nodes.summary: Provides the SessionStore class for managing agent work sessions (GOP-linked) in SQLite, supporting session lifecycle (create, close, archive) and idempotent ensure-active semantics.

nodes.name: SessionStore
nodes.summary: SQLite session store that links sessions to GOP IDs and project IDs, with transactional ensureActive for idempotent session bootstrapping and methods for listing active, project-scoped, and archived sessions.

nodes.name: multi-mind-cache.ts
nodes.summary: Provides the MultiMindCache class implementing an LRU cache of open MindDB connections keyed by workspace path, with path traversal prevention and automatic eviction when the connection limit is reached.

nodes.name: MultiMindCache
nodes.summary: LRU connection cache for MindDB instances keyed by workspace path, with configurable max-open limit, path-traversal guard against directory escape, last-accessed timestamps, and graceful eviction.

nodes.name: multi-mind.ts
nodes.summary: Provides the MultiMind class that federates search across personal and workspace MindDB instances, merging FTS results by recency and exposing unified awareness and identity accessors for dual-context agent operation.

nodes.name: MultiMind
nodes.summary: Dual-mind façade that runs FTS search over both personal and workspace SQLite databases, merges results sorted by recency, and provides unified getters for identity, awareness, frames, and sessions.

nodes.name: entity-normalizer.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for entity name normalization and deduplication logic (normalizeEntityName, findDuplicates, isLikelyAcronym, isNoiseName).

nodes.name: caption-parity.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests caption extraction parity across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Universal harvest adapters, verifying that each adapter produces consistent conversation captions.

nodes.name: claude-adapter.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the Claude conversation export harvest adapter, verifying correct parsing, turn extraction, and metadata handling from Claude export JSON format.

nodes.name: extract-kg-entities.test.ts
nodes.summary: Integration tests for KG entity extraction from harvested conversations using a static LLM mock, verifying that entities are correctly extracted and written to the knowledge graph.

nodes.name: extract-memory-lanes.test.ts
nodes.summary: Integration tests for memory lane extraction (facts, events, profiles) from harvested conversations using mock LLMs, verifying correct frame writing and lane classification.

nodes.name: perplexity-adapter.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the Perplexity conversation export harvest adapter, verifying parsing and extraction of search conversations with citations.

nodes.name: pipeline-injection.test.ts
nodes.summary: Security tests verifying the HarvestPipeline blocks prompt injection attacks embedded in conversation content before they reach the LLM extraction step.

nodes.name: pipeline-progress.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for HarvestPipeline progress tracking and callback invocation, verifying correct stage reporting during multi-step harvest operations.

nodes.name: raw-turns.test.ts
nodes.summary: Integration tests for raw turn frame writing and retrieval, verifying that raw conversation turns are correctly stored in memory_frames with proper MIND_RAWTURN_PREFIX headers and per-conversation limits.

nodes.name: run-store.test.ts
nodes.summary: Integration tests for HarvestRunStore covering run creation, status transitions (pending → done/error), deduplication, and listing across multiple harvest sources.

nodes.name: set-hash.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the harvestSetHash and dedup utilities verifying content-hash computation and set-based deduplication of harvest items.

nodes.name: logger.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for createCoreLogger verifying log level filtering, output format, and muting/unmuting behavior.

nodes.name: awareness-hive-mind.test.ts
nodes.summary: Integration tests for AwarenessLayer in a real MindDB context, verifying set/get/clear operations for active task and context state across multiple workspaces.

nodes.name: awareness.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for AwarenessLayer covering full CRUD of awareness items, expiry filtering, and clearing behavior against an in-memory SQLite database.
